text.label: Add to list
text.description: Add an item to your shopping list.
text.agent: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity out when they gave none.

text.label: Share list
text.description: Share your shopping list with someone in your household.
text.agent: Share the person's shopping list with another person, who can then see and change it. The person confirms first.
text.confirm: Share your shopping list with someone in your household.

mcp.why: person-only: only the person starts it, so every agent door answers the typed refusal

appAction.why: person-only: only the person starts it, so every agent door answers the typed refusal

text.label: Place order
text.description: Order everything on your list and pay for it.
text.agent: Order the shopping list's items for delivery and pay for them.
